name: Notara
summary: A front-desk app for a music school: lessons on a piano roll, check-ins, fees and recitals
about: A nine-page desk app for a music, dance or art school. Today's lessons play out as notes on room lanes with a live playhead, the week schedule takes drag-and-drop rescheduling, and students, teachers, invoices, rental instruments and recital running orders all work with sample data.
how: Open Front desk: lessons glide in as notes on each room lane and the gold playhead marks the time
Click a note or press Check in to mark a student as arrived; the KPIs and room meters update
Open Schedule and drag a lesson to a new day or time, or press Enter on it and use Move to…
Search, filter and sort Students, then click a row for the profile drawer with lessons and invoices
Take a payment or raise this month's invoices in Billing and watch the stacked chart grow
Rent out or return instruments, reorder the recital programme by dragging, and sell seats
Switch light or dark theme, edit fees and reset the demo data in Settings
